items.title: tt-a1i/archify
items.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
items.author: tt-a1i
items.summary_zh: Archify 是一个基于 Node.js 的渲染与校验系统，支持 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 OpenCode，能在聊天中把代码库或系统描述变成可交互的系统图。它把 agent 输出的 JSON IR 编译为自包含 HTML/SVG，支持五种图表类型、四套预设、明暗主题，并用 Before/Delta/After 对比在合并前审查架构变化。
items.summary_en: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It turns a codebase or system description into an interactive system map directly in chat, compiling typed JSON IR into self-contained HTML/SVG. It ships with five diagram types, four presets, light/dark themes, and Before/Delta/After snapshots for reviewing architecture changes before merge.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 作者从 2025 年 4 月用到 2026 年 4 月，因 Cursor 转向按量计费后费用不可预测，公司决定改用 OpenAI Codex。体验半个月后，作者认为 Codex 不仅是编程助手，更像一个真正的超级 Agent，而 Cursor 的优势在于贴近编辑器、支持 Tab 补全和主流模型切换。
items.summary_en: After a year on Cursor, the author's company switched to OpenAI Codex in April 2026 because Cursor moved to usage-based pricing that became more expensive and unpredictable. Two weeks into the switch, he sees Codex as a genuine super-agent, not just a coding assistant, while Cursor's strengths remain in tight editor integration, Tab completion, and the freedom to choose mainstream models.

items.title: 腾讯混元 Hy4 preview 开源，参与“训练自己”！WorkBuddy实测：有了小型团队交付实力，但还得有人盯
items.summary_zh: 腾讯开源混元 Hy4 preview，总参数 770B、激活 49B，上下文超 1M，主打 Agent、Coding 与生产力场景。它在自研全链路中参与训练与算子优化，形成初步递归自我改进闭环，并将端到端吞吐提升 31.8%；API 输入 6 元/百万 tokens，WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 限时免费两周。
items.summary_en: Tencent has open-sourced Hunyuan Hy4 preview with 770B total parameters, 49B active, and 1M+ context, tuned for agent, coding, and productivity tasks. It was involved in optimizing its own training and operators, forming a recursive self-improvement loop, and improving end-to-end throughput by 31.8%. API pricing is 6 CNY input and 18 CNY output per million tokens; WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy are free for two weeks.

items.summary_zh: 一位北京 V 友发帖求健康又好吃的午餐推荐，要求是普通家常菜、但不自己动手做。楼主认为多数餐馆油、咸、辣，外卖和食堂也难达标，因此想听听大家的建议；目前帖内还没有具体方案。

They note most restaurants are too oily, salty and spicy, while takeout and canteens also fail their health standards, so they are looking for community suggestions. No specific options are in the post yet.

items.title: [奇思妙想] 垂直领域 Coding 场景意图识别模型开放权重与 API 使用
items.summary_zh: 作者为 PI Agent 的意图路由训练了 0.6B 的 Coding 场景意图识别模型，基于 jina-embeddings-v5 微调，支持 12 项 ops/coding 信号，内部网关使用半个月准确率约 70-75%，显著降低成本。模型权重以 CC BY-NC 4.0 发布在 Hugging Face，另有 woq8 量化版和公益 API，源码已开源，方便社区测试部署。
items.summary_en: To route intents for PI Agent, the author trained a 0.6B intent-classification model for coding scenarios, fine-tuned from jina-embeddings-v5 and supporting 12 ops/coding signals; after two weeks in an internal gateway it hits roughly 70-75% accuracy while cutting costs. Weights are on Hugging Face under CC BY-NC 4.0, with a woq8 quantized version and a free public API, and the API source is open-sourced so others can test and deploy it.

items.title: 1周半写64个PR、完成30%项目重构：一家成熟SaaS公司把Agent塞进研发全流程后
items.summary_zh: 日程 SaaS 公司 Calendly 公开了将 AI Agent 嵌入研发流程的实践：Agent 先审 Jira 需求、拆解任务，再并行写代码、跑测试和 QA，人类负责最终 Review 与 Merge。其 IAM 团队一周半生成 64 个 PR，完成约 30% 的大型解耦项目重构。Calendly 的结论是，工程瓶颈正从写代码转向需求对齐和判断力。
items.summary_en: Calendly, a scheduling SaaS company, detailed how it embeds AI agents across Jira, GitHub, CI and production workflows: agents review requirements, split tasks, write code in parallel, run tests and QA, with humans doing final review and merge. In its IAM team, agents generated 64 PRs in one and a half weeks and completed about 30% of a large decoupling project. The takeaway: the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to requirement alignment and judgment.

items.title: 你的 Agent 已经上线生产环境，下一步怎么办？ | 技术实践
items.summary_zh: Snowflake 为 Cortex Agents 增加了一系列新能力，面向已把 Agent 投入生产的企业，解决编排、执行和治理上的运营难题。亮点包括 Async Agent API、Interrupt and Resume、Partial Access 和可视化版本管理 UI，并推出 Build Coding Agent 等公开预览功能，目标是让智能体从“能构建”走向“可规模化运营”。
items.summary_en: Snowflake is expanding Cortex Agents with new capabilities for enterprises running agents in production, targeting operational pain points in orchestration, execution, and governance. Highlights include the Async Agent API, interrupt/resume, partial access controls, and a versioning UI, along with previews like Build Coding Agent and Tool Search — aimed at moving agents from "buildable" to "operable at scale."

items.summary_zh: V2EX 上有人推广 Claude Team Plan 合租方案：以新加坡公司开员工号并配企业网络代理，模拟员工出差场景以降低封号风险，声称 4 月以来稳定。提供 Standard/Premium 两档额度，分别为官方 Pro 订阅的 1.25/6.25 倍，强调直连官方、非中转站。

The approach provisions 'employee accounts' with a corporate network proxy to mimic normal business travel usage and claims to prevent bans since April. Plans offer 1.25x or 6.25x the quota of an official Pro subscription, with direct official connections and no relay.

items.title: 智谱认领“牛来”模型，实测：“牛马”友好
items.summary_zh: 此前匿名出现在 OpenRouter 的模型 Ox Alpha 被智谱认领为 GLM-5.3-Flash。它采用 3200 亿总参数的 MoE 架构，每次仅激活约 180 亿参数，匿名测试版提供 104 万 Token 上下文，支持文本、图片和视频输入。Stripe CEO Patrick Collison 称其“非常令人印象深刻”，测试流量由国产 AI 芯片集群承载。
items.summary_en: Zhipu confirmed that Ox Alpha, the anonymous model that climbed OpenRouter's trending list, is GLM-5.3-Flash. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 320B total parameters but only about 18B active per token; the anonymous test version offered 1.04M-token context and accepted text, image, and video input. Stripe CEO Patrick Collison said it was 'very impressive,' and Zhipu said all test traffic ran on clusters built with domestic AI chips.

items.title: 谷歌落后一个时代？CEO 亲自官宣“语音转文字”模型，网友：你们看不清形势啊
items.summary_zh: 谷歌发布号称迄今最精确的语音转文本模型 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，CEO Pichai 在 X 上宣布。它能自动清理语气词、口误和重复，理解“不，改成周三”这类自我修正，支持 85 种以上语言和实时切换，并识别最多 8 位说话人。据 Artificial Analysis，流式转录词错误率 4.0%，非流式 2.6%。
items.summary_en: Google unveiled Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, which CEO Pichai announced on X as its most accurate speech-to-text model. It cleans up fillers, mistakes, and repetitions, understands self-corrections like 'no, make it Wednesday,' supports 85+ languages with live switching, and can identify up to eight speakers. According to Artificial Analysis, word error rate is 4.0% for streaming and 2.6% for non-streaming transcription.

items.title: 从方案走向运行｜世界人工智能开源大赛（GOAI）复赛作品提交正式开启
items.summary_zh: GOAI复赛提交已开启：赛道一至三须在9月3日18:00前提交，赛道四调试安排在9月中下旬。作品要求提高，赛道一须用AgentTeams框架组合至少3个职能不同的Agent，并提供验证材料、可执行代码和Demo；线上答辩为9月4-6日。
items.summary_en: The World AI Open Source Competition (GOAI) has entered its rematch round: tracks 1–3 must submit by Sept 3 18:00, while track 4 debugging runs into mid-September. The Agent Infra track now demands an AgentTeams-based design with at least three distinct agents, along with validation, code, and a demo video. Online defenses are Sept 4–6.

items.title: Cloudflare 发布 Kitesurf，一款面向 AI 智能智能体的浏览器引擎
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 推出面向 AI 智能体的轻量级浏览器 Kitesurf，在 Workers 的 WebAssembly/Rust 隔离环境中运行，支持 Chrome DevTools 协议，让 Playwright 和 Puppeteer 以低于完整 Chromium 的资源开销驱动。它基于 Rust 的 Blitz 渲染引擎和 Firefox 的 Stylo CSS 解析器，暂不支持视频、WebGL 和真实环境 TLS 机器人验证。Hacker News 上已有用户质疑 CDN 提供商做浏览器是否存在利益冲突。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare released Kitesurf, a lightweight browser engine built for AI agents. It runs browser components in isolated WebAssembly/Rust environments on Cloudflare Workers, supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol, so Playwright and Puppeteer can drive it with lower overhead than full Chromium. Built on the Rust-based Blitz rendering engine and Firefox's Stylo CSS parser, it omits video, WebGL, and real-world TLS bot checks; some Hacker News commenters raised conflict-of-interest concerns because Cloudflare runs a large CDN and security services.

items.title: 规模化 AI 代码审查：LinkedIn 的多智能体方案
items.summary_zh: LinkedIn自建了多智能体AI代码审查平台，用多个独立审查员（不同模型与推理方式）交叉验证，并把组织策略、代码库约定和特定规则纳入定制，以降低幻觉和噪音。评估显示，在1727个PR的5230条抽样评论中，63.9%的建议被最终采纳；逻辑错误采纳率80%，并发缺陷达100%。
items.summary_en: LinkedIn built a multi-agent AI code review platform instead of bolting a generic tool onto GitHub. It combines independent reviewers using different models and reasoning methods, applies organization- and repo-specific rules, and filters noise. In an evaluation of 5,230 sampled comments across 1,727 PRs, 63.9% of suggestions were adopted; logic-error and concurrency fixes were accepted 80% and 100% of the time respectively.

items.title: 下一层抽象：从UX角度思考Agentic OS的样貌
items.summary_zh: InfoQ 从 UX 角度讨论 Agentic OS：GUI 虽隐藏了复杂度，但仍要求用户把意图翻译成软件操作，例如用户只知道视频模糊，界面上却给出编码器、比特率等参数。作者认为技术用户把多年积累的电脑经验误当常识，Agent 类界面可能成为下一层抽象，让用户直接表达目标而非操作命令。
items.summary_en: This InfoQ opinion piece looks at Agentic OS from a UX perspective. GUIs already hide complexity, but they still force users to translate intent into software operations: a user sees a blurry video while the app offers codec, bitrate, and resolution settings. The author argues that power users mistake hard-won computer experience for common sense, and agent interfaces may be the next abstraction layer for expressing goals directly.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了一个在线 Lip Sync 工具，想听听大家的体验反馈
items.summary_zh: 作者在 V2EX 分享自建的在线 Lipsync 工具 lipsync.vip：上传人物或宠物图片和音频，即可生成嘴型同步视频，流程只有上传、加音频、生成三步。作者重点解决嘴型对不上、头部乱动、表情变形等问题，并希望收到首次使用时的卡点反馈，而非简单夸奖。
items.summary_en: A developer shared lipsync.vip on V2EX, an online AI lip-sync tool that turns a photo of a person or pet plus audio into a talking video. The pipeline is intentionally simple: upload, add audio, generate. The creator wants feedback on first-run confusion and known pain points like mismatched mouth movements, head motion, and deformation.

items.title: [Java] 开源:用刚发布的 Spring AI 2.0.1，撸了一个全功能 Agent
items.summary_zh: 作者在 V2EX 宣布开源 hermes-agent-demo：用 Spring AI 2.0.1 配合 JDK 25 和 Spring Boot 4.1 实现服务端 Agent，支持联网搜索、网页抓取、MCP 热插拔、子代理、RAG、Human-in-the-Loop 审批和沙箱代码执行，兼容 Anthropic/DeepSeek/OpenAI 及自定义模型。除前端打包版外已全部开源，适合作为 AI 项目的脚手架。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user open-sourced hermes-agent-demo, a server-side agent built with the newly released Spring AI 2.0.1, JDK 25, and Spring Boot 4.1. It supports web search, page scraping, hot-swappable MCP, subagents, RAG, human-in-the-loop approval, and sandboxed code execution, with Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenAI, and custom model backends. All is open source except a packaged frontend; the author recommends it as a starting scaffold for AI projects.

items.title: [macOS] 赛博药方——macOS 废纸篓删除已锁定 app 的方法（症状：无法完成此操作，因为必须跳过某些项目。）
items.summary_zh: 针对 macOS 删除已锁定 App 时提示“无法完成此操作，因为必须跳过某些项目”的情况，作者给出的办法是：在废纸篓中右键“显示包内容”，然后把 Contents 目录的共享与权限改为“读和写”并应用到包含项目。作者说在 AI 和论坛都没找到现成答案，适合被类似问题卡住的用户照做。
items.summary_en: A macOS troubleshooting post for the 'There was a problem... some items must be skipped' error when emptying Trash. The fix is to right-click the stuck app, select Show Package Contents, then set the Contents folder's Sharing & Permissions to 'Read & Write' for all users and apply to enclosed items. The author found no solution in AI tools or forums, so this is a practical workaround for affected users.

items.summary_en: Enter Pro is an AI-native platform for building and scaling applications, marketed as a tool to take apps from development to growth with AI assistance. Only a one-sentence description is public so far, with no technical specifications, making it an early-stage signal for teams evaluating AI-centric development tools. It comes from the viral God's Eye View YouTube series (5M+ views) and offers hands-free voice control via a realtime AI agent; modeled views are clearly labeled when no live feed exists. Great for developers into open-source geospatial visualization and real-time data mashups.

items.title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
items.author: TangerineDream
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 团队分享了为 1.1.1.1 DNS 缓存（代号 Big Pineapple）做的 5 项 Rust 层内存优化，单条缓存记录内存占用降低 56%，整个服务集群释放约 100 TB 内存。对做 DNS 基础设施或大规模 Rust 性能优化的工程师有直接参考价值。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare describes five Rust-level memory optimizations applied to the DNS cache layout behind 1.1.1.1 (internally codenamed Big Pineapple). Per-entry memory dropped by 56%, freeing roughly 100 TB of memory across the company's fleet. Worth reading if you work on DNS infrastructure or large-scale Rust performance tuning.

Relevant for teams using AI assistants in Go projects.

items.summary_zh: dotnet/aspnetcore 是 ASP.NET Core 这个跨平台 .NET 框架所在的仓库，用于在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上构建现代云端 Web 应用。它登上 GitHub 趋势榜，是 .NET Web 开发者的基础参照；跨平台支持让非 Windows 环境的开发与部署更现实。
items.summary_en: The dotnet/aspnetcore repo is the repository for ASP.NET Core, a cross-platform .NET framework for building modern cloud-based web applications on Windows, Mac, or Linux. It is currently trending on GitHub, making it a timely reference for .NET web developers. Its cross-platform support matters for teams that don't want to lock into Windows-only hosting.

items.title: alibaba/page-agent
items.description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
items.author: alibaba
items.summary_zh: alibaba/page-agent 是一个 JavaScript 实现的页内 GUI 代理，能够用自然语言指令操控网页界面。它直接运行在页面内，省去浏览器扩展或外部驱动的额外依赖，适合做网页自动化与 AI 助手原型。仓库目前只有简短介绍，具体用法需以 README 为准。
items.summary_en: alibaba/page-agent is a JavaScript in-page GUI agent that lets you control web interfaces with natural language. Running directly inside the page, it avoids the need for browser extensions or external drivers, making it a convenient starting point for web automation and AI-assisted browsing. The repository only ships a brief description, so check the README for implementation details.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and VPS.
items.author: stablyai
items.summary_zh: stablyai/orca 是一个面向并行 agent 集群的 ADE，官方介绍称可以用自己的订阅运行任意编码 agent，并支持桌面、移动端和 VPS。它试图把多个 agent 的调度、运行集中到一个工具里，适合需要同时跑多个编码任务的开发者。仓库详情不多，具体工作方式需看 README。
items.summary_en: stablyai/orca is an ADE (agent development environment) for working with a fleet of parallel agents. According to the description, you can run any coding agent with your own subscription, on desktop, mobile, or a VPS. It's aimed at developers who want a single tool to coordinate multiple coding agents, though the repository listing is light on specifics.

items.title: jenkinsci/jenkins
items.description: Jenkins automation server
items.author: jenkinsci
items.summary_zh: Jenkins 自动化服务器的官方 GitHub 仓库，也是该项目的主要维护入口，本周出现在 GitHub 趋势榜上。仓库描述只有“自动化服务器”一句，更多更新细节未提供。
items.summary_en: The official GitHub repository for Jenkins, the widely used automation server. It appears in this GitHub trending list. Beyond the repository name and the "automation server" description, no further details are provided in this digest.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 350 providers (90+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 450+ contributors
items.author: diegosouzapw
items.summary_zh: OmniRoute 是一个免费的开源 AI 网关项目，它提供了一个统一端点，让你能访问超过 290 个提供商（其中 90 多个免费）和 500 多种模型，包括 Kimi、Claude、GPT、Gemini 等主流模型。开发者只需要接入一个 API 就可以调用几乎所有的前沿模型，不再需要为每个服务商单独申请和集成，大大降低了实验和开发的门槛。对于 AI 应用开发者来说，这是一个极大的便利。
items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway that exposes a single endpoint to access over 290 providers (90+ free) and 500+ models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, and many more. Developers can now call almost any cutting-edge model through one API, eliminating the need for separate integrations and sign-ups. This dramatically lowers the barrier for AI experimentation and development, making it a huge boon for AI application builders.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.author: MadsLorentzen
items.summary_zh: 这个开源项目是基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职应用框架，完全在本地运行，涵盖评估职位信息、定制简历、撰写求职信和面试准备等环节。它是可自主 Fork 和定制的工作流模板，适合想用 Claude Code 自动化求职流程的开发者。
items.summary_en: This open-source project is an AI job application framework built on Claude Code, designed to run on your own machine. It automates the full pipeline: evaluating job postings, tailoring CVs, writing cover letters, and prepping for interviews. Since it's forkable, developers can own and customize the workflow to fit their specific job-search needs.

items.title: bojieli/ai-agent-book
items.description: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》（李博杰 著）开源主仓库：全书正文、编译版 PDF 与按章配套代码
items.author: bojieli
items.summary_zh: 这是李博杰所著《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》的开源主仓库，包含全书正文、编译版 PDF 以及按章节配套的代码。适合想系统学习 AI Agent 设计原理和工程实践、并希望结合代码阅读的开发者。
items.summary_en: This is the open-source main repository for Li Bojie's "深入理解 AI Agent: 设计原理与工程实践" (Understanding AI Agents: Design Principles and Engineering Practice), housing the full text, a compiled PDF, and chapter-by-chapter companion code. It's for developers who want to study AI agent design and engineering systematically, with code to follow along.
